title: Just what I was looking for
text: Just what I was looking for. I discovered that I have been using these types of shoe racks the wrong way my whole life. Now that I'm putting the shoes on the right way, it's working much better. LOL

product_metadata.title: Honey-Can-Do 18 Pair OTD Shoe Rack SHO-01169 White, 30 lbs
description: Honey-Can-Do SHO-01169 18 Pair Over-the-Door Shoe Rack. Space saving, over-the-door shoe rack eliminates closet floor clutter by neatly displaying up to 18 pair of shoes in an easily accessible format. The rack's sturdy, rust-resistant steel frame hangs easily over any standard size door. Wire shoe forms help to hold the shape of your shoes while allowing some flexibility for varying styles and sizes.

This over the door shoe rack provides practical and safe storage for 18 pairs of shoes. Easily attaches to any standard size door to save valuable floor storage space. The steel frame is coated with an attractive white finish. Another winning product from Honey-Can-Do
